summary: US-Iran tensions sharply escalated with President Trump threatening a year-long bombing campaign against Iran if it attempts to assassinate him, while imposing new sanctions targeting Mojtaba Khamenei's financial network in response to Iranian attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran faces simultaneous pressure: a major petrochemical refinery fire in Lorestan, satellite imagery showing damage to Jordan's Muwaffaq Salti base from Iranian shelling, and a US ultimatum to declare the Strait of Hormuz open and cease fire or face severe consequences. Israel conducted fresh attacks on southern Lebanon violating the ceasefire, while the US evacuated F-22 Raptors from Israel's Ovda base and the USS Boxer carrier group was sidelined by mechanical failure, reducing rapid response capacity in the region.
key_points: Trump declared 1,000 missiles 'locked and loaded' aimed at Iran, with orders for a one-year bombing campaign to 'completely decimate and destroy all areas of Iran' if Tehran attempts to assassinate him. (Source: @shin_persian/7643)

US Treasury sanctioned Ali Ansari, described as a financial facilitator for Mojtaba Khamenei, and several Iranian exchange houses, citing Iranian attacks on commercial vessels in the Strait of Hormuz. (Source: @VahidOnline/76924)
Iranian media released satellite images claiming destruction of at least two hangars at Jordan's Muwaffaq Salti base from Iranian shelling two days prior. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/376114)

Senior US officials demanded Iran issue a public statement confirming all Strait of Hormuz waterways are open and cease fire, warning of 'dire consequences' if not complied by the next day. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/75464)
Israeli military carried out fresh attacks on southern Lebanon in violation of the ceasefire agreement, per Press TV. (Source: @presstv/198222)
Drone strikes hit Nabatieh al-Fawqa and Kfar Tibnit in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/30900, @redlinkleb/30925)

The USS Boxer amphibious assault ship and 11th MEU were diverted to Diego Garcia for repairs after a cooling system failure, degrading US rapid response during the naval blockade of Iran. (Source: @naya_foriraq/82345)
Qatar is mediating talks between the US and Iran to de-escalate tensions, while Iranian Foreign Minister Araghchi is set to visit Oman. (Source: @asafroz/51263, @shin_persian/7642)
